purpose: Test a data-first, architecture-preserving repair for the Step-12/13 graph-conditioned out-of-distribution mechanism-classification failure by warm-starting the frozen Step-10C ensemble and adding a leakage-safe cross-motif simulator training domain with family-level held-out selection and outer evaluation.

frozen_findings: Step-10C fully ideal diagnostic replay mechanism correctness = 8/18.
cz_echo_ramsey remains 0/6 under both hardware and exact ideal diagnostics.
The acquired Step-12 QPU evidence retains mechanism-specific structure; simple hardware-evidence collapse is not supported as the primary failure explanation.
Learned out-of-distribution mapping/generalization is supported as the primary failure class; the exact neural subcomponent remains unresolved.

scientific_question: Can broader leakage-safe circuit-context coverage alone, without changing the architecture, input contract, loss definition, or QPU acquisition contract, materially improve cross-motif RZ/RX/RY mechanism generalization while retaining the previously learned original and Step-10 bridge capabilities?

architecture.current_layout_semantics: The frozen Step-7 graph adapter uses x__layout_logical_to_physical only to determine logical qubit count and does not expose absolute physical-qubit IDs as node/edge/gate features. Step 14 therefore does not claim or attempt absolute-layout-ID invariance training.

warm_start.reason_no_scratch: Step 14 tests a targeted data/generalization repair of the already selected hardware-facing checkpoint. Reopening initialization choice would add an unnecessary factor and contradict the checkpoint-reuse policy after Step 10C/10D.

circuit_grammar.affected_qubit_sampling: uniform over active logical qubits subject to legal injection-boundary constraints
legal_injection_boundary_requires: at least one operation on the affected logical qubit before the injection
at least one noncommuting operation on the affected logical qubit after the injection
at least one entangling operation in the reference circuit
the same injection boundary is used for the RZ/RX/RY triplet at a given root and strength
circuit_grammar.family_variant_rule: One seed-generated reference skeleton defines a family. Four roots are created by resampling continuous gate angles and allowed spectator single-qubit slots while preserving the family skeleton and injection-context class.

strength_design.sampling: one deterministic uniform draw from each ordered interval
strength_design.interval_convention: first three bins are half-open [low, high); final bin is closed [low, high]

shot_design.strength_to_shot_assignment: deterministic root-seeded permutation; each of the four strengths uses each shot level exactly once and the same mapping is used for RZ/RX/RY
shot_design.clean_shot_level: deterministic root-seeded uniform choice from the same four shot levels

layout_policy.reason: Under the frozen Step-7 adapter, absolute physical IDs are not model features. Randomizing unused IDs would be scientifically inert and would falsely imply layout-invariance training.

model_blind_identifiability_admission.failed_family_action: reject the entire family and deterministically advance to the next generator seed

simulation_noise_policy.rationale: Step 13 does not support hardware-evidence collapse as the primary failure. Step 14 isolates circuit-context coverage rather than simultaneously introducing a device-noise intervention.

training.domain_schedule: equal optimizer-block count per epoch from legacy original fit, legacy Step-10 bridge fit, and Step-14 cross-motif fit; shorter block lists cycle deterministically

per_seed_checkpoint_selection.baseline: matching-seed frozen Step-10C checkpoint evaluated on the same Step-14 development selection partitions before Step-14 training
eligibility: legacy original selection mechanism balanced accuracy >= matching-seed Step-10C baseline - 0.02
legacy Step-10 bridge selection mechanism balanced accuracy >= matching-seed Step-10C baseline - 0.02
eligible_checkpoint_order: Step-14 cross-motif selection mechanism balanced accuracy
minimum(legacy original selection mechanism BA, legacy Step-10 bridge selection mechanism BA)

ensemble_effect_threshold.selection_data: concatenated legacy original selection + legacy Step-10 bridge selection + Step-14 cross-motif selection ensemble mean effect logits
ensemble_effect_threshold.objective: maximize macro-average effect balanced accuracy across the three selection domains
tie_break_order: threshold closest to frozen Step-10C threshold

fresh_legacy_retention_outer.generation_semantics: same frozen legacy original/Step-10 bridge generators and label semantics, new seed namespace only

outer_evaluation.candidate: Step-14 three-seed warm-start ensemble after frozen per-seed selection
outer_evaluation.primary_baseline: frozen Step-10C warm-start ensemble evaluated on exactly the same newly materialized Step-14 outer cohorts

post_outer_policy.step12_replay_role: report-only known-failure repair diagnostic; never part of Step-14 selection or support gate
post_outer_policy.if_support_gate_passes: Step 15 may freeze a new blind hardware protocol using only the untouched future-hardware-reserve fold and no Step-12 case reuse.
post_outer_policy.if_support_gate_fails: Do not spend Step-15 QPU shots. Freeze a representation/fusion/head decomposition on fixed Step-14 data before considering any architecture change.

implementation_may_fix_engineering_detai: runtime compatibility that does not alter generated examples, model inputs, optimizer trajectory, selection, or evaluation
